identificationModule.briefTitle: Donafenib for Previously Treated Metastatic Colorectal Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Donafenib in Patients With Previously Treated Metastatic Colorectal Cancer:a Controlled,Multicentre,Randomised, Phase 3 Trial

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The investigators do the clinical trial (patients with metastatic colorectal cancer treated with donafenib/placebo after failure of standard therapy) to assess efficacy and safety of donafenib in patients with metastatic colorectal cancer, progressing after all approved standard therapies.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription:
The study is a randomization,multicentre, phase 3 study recruiting 510 patients. Patients were eligible to participate when they have histological or cytological documentation of adenocarcinoma of the colon or rectum. They must have received locally and currently approved standard therapies and to have disease progression during or within 3 months after the last administration of the last standard therapy or to have stopped standard therapy because of unacceptable toxic effects. The available standard therapies have to include as many of the following as were licensed: a fluoropyrimidine,oxaliplatin,irinotecan.

All patients receive best supportive care, excluding other investigational antitumour agents or antineoplastic chemotherapy, hormonal therapy, or immunotherapy.

Patients receive oral donafenib 300mg (CM4307) on days 1-21 of each 4 weeks cycle until disease progression,death,or the unacceptable toxic effects.The primary endpoint is overall survival.The second endpoint is progression-free survival.

armGroups.label: Donafenib
armGroups.description: Donafenib 300mg bid on 1-21 days of each 28 days cycle.

armGroups.label: Placebo
armGroups.description: Placebo 300mg bid on 1-21days of each 28 days cycle.

primaryOutcomes.description: OS is defined as the time from date of randomization to death due to any cause. Subjects still alive at the time of analysis were censored at their last date of last contact.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From randomization of the first subject until 316 death events observed, up to 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.description: PFS was defined as the time from date of randomization to disease progression radiological or death due to any cause, whichever occurs first. Subjects without progression or death at the time of analysis were censored at their last date of tumor evaluation.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From randomization of the first subject until 316 death events observed, up to 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.description: DCR is defined as the percentage of subjects whose best response was not Progressive Disease (PD) according to Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) (= total number of Complete Response (CR) + total number of Partial Response (PR) + total number of Stable Disease (SD); CR, PR, or SD had to be maintained for at least 28 days from the first demonstration of that rating)
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From randomization of the first subject until 316 death events observed, up to 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Safety variables will be summarized using descriptive statistics based on adverse events collection
